entities.name: System Information Block 11
entities.description: System Information Block 11 containing system information broadcast by the network.

entities.name: Timer T331
entities.description: Timer used in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE states for system information procedures.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is idle with no active connection.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is inactive with suspended connection.

entities.name: T331 running condition
entities.description: Condition where timer T331 is currently running.

entities.name: Actions specified in 5.7.8.1a
entities.description: Procedural actions defined in clause 5.7.8.1a of TS 38.331.

relations.description: Reception of SIB11 triggers evaluation of T331 running condition.
Condition requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state.
Condition requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Condition checks if timer T331 is running.
When condition is met, UE performs actions specified in clause 5.7.8.1a.
